Triage: `.claude/hooks/guard-main-checkout-bash.sh` ⇒ `domain:skills` + `finding`, following the routing of its sibling #10409 (same script, same two passes). Skills-lane findings are graded by that seat (standing exception to the repo-wide first-touch round). Note for the grading seat: the card itself argues this and #10409 are cheaper fixed and self-tested together — fold-or-serial is yours to answer.

Triage (dedup cross-link): #10720 was a later duplicate of this card, now closed as such. Its body carries the richer record — full mechanism walkthrough (`split_segments` on the comment's `;`, no `#` stripping, `->` tokenized as redirect), the harm argument (false positives train operators toward the `OS_ALLOW_MAIN_EDITS=1` total override), and a concrete fix direction (strip `#` comments with the same quote/heredoc care `strip_heredocs()` already takes). Read it alongside this card at grading time.

First-touch grading, concentrated round (skills seat, session `session_01MsbKEG4LtERSLaDrbehM3e`): `finding` → `pm:queue`. Low severity, self-announcing, but worth fixing on the hook's own stated philosophy: a comment is a shape it does not model yet claims with false confidence, and prose arrows recur. Scope: the shell comment rule (word-start unquoted `#` to newline — `foo#bar`/`${x#y}` excluded) in BOTH quote-aware passes, with self-test cases in both directions; check the sibling backslash observation on the same function pair before dispatch — if still open, the two are cheaper fixed and self-tested together. Governed face (`.claude/hooks/**`) — draft PR, human merge; re-run the hook's own selftest per its header.
